items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: Well, that was George Stewart's band when it was playing out there. At the late... Yeah, just like when it was playing over there, it was Billy's band.

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: They play on the Canada Street.

Yeah, where did you play there? What was the job? Whose band and all? Well, when we played those picnics, that was this... That Japanese... I mean Gypsy... The name of this place was George Stewart. The leader of the band, that was the... The leader was the band was named after him in a way of speaking. His name. Well, that was George Stewart's band when it was playing out there. At the late... Yeah, just like when it was playing over there, it was Billy's band. Yeah. When you played on Decatur Street, where was…

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: That was the Black Diamond in it?
